Wait, I need to re-examine this against the rules more carefully before outputting.

The lead said "I will check." The draft:
- Rule 8: Brings up passport, email, move-in confirmation, deposit, viewing time, none of which the lead asked about. .
- Rule 11: Asks for passport and mentions costs/deposit when lead hasn't asked to proceed. .
- Rule 12: Repeats deposit/cost info not previously stated but brings up unsolicited financial details. .
- Rule 13: Too long, more than 3 sentences. .
- Rule 6: "what time works best between 9am and 6pm?" is a reasonable CTA but the whole reply is bloated.


Take your time. Once you've had a look, let me know if Thursday still works for the viewing.
